Name: HxW Forest Cafe Flooring
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/buIbPlm.png[/img]

Looking for some flowery, forest-y, cottagecore floors to pair with your new set of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35049]Forest Cafe Furniture[/url]﻿?

Of course you are! 

This mod is actually three mods - choose from one, two or all three to add up to 36 customizable flooring retextures to your game! It uses Alternative Textures, so no need for concern about compatibility with your other path mods. Each color set includes the plain/unadorned version, as well as 11 other flowers to choose from![/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3] 

[b]How to use:[/b] simply purchase the paint bucket from Robin and[b] click on any cobblestone path [/b]you've placed to choose a new texture!

[i](Why cobblestone path? Because I always have too much stone and not enough wood in game so I made it easy for myself hehe)[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y8dJ6qH.png[/img]

Credit to my partner in crime [b][url=https://himetarts.wixsite.com/artsite]HimeTarts[/url][/b] for her gorgeous art and gorgeous self. <3

Credit to [url=https://ko-fi.com/ty_ty]Taiyo[/url] for our amazing flower bases !

Credit to [url=https://ko-fi.com/whitelotus]PlatinumCats[/url] for some of her small flowers from the trees I commissioned her for to be used in Rose and the Alchemist.

Credit to sophie for teaching me about local tokens and making furniture modding even easier. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2bSyOpH.png[/img]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5]
